adventures.name: Ugly Sweater Run
adventures.matchSource: Strava activity description 'Ugly Sweater Run!' + exact December 1, 2012 date + 2:07 PM Watson Park GPS start + contemporary Lawrence event coverage + user confirmation
adventures.note: Contemporary Lawrence coverage identifies the December 1, 2012 Ugly Sweater Run as a 5K starting at 2:00 PM at Watson Park. The matched Strava activity begins at 2:07 PM from Watson Park and its own description says 'Ugly Sweater Run!'. The FIT recording captured 3.9461 km in 25:09, so the official 5K distance remains canonical while 25:09 is retained only as the recorded Strava elapsed time, not asserted as an official chip result.
